title: "Lisbon Airport"

This Quarto document lists the data preparatory action for integrating Lisbon airport, LPPT.
The APDF data for LPPT was extracted from ECTRL data warehouse and stored locally.    
This script is not reproducible if the ADPF data are not accessible.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)

source(here::here("R","rqutils-zip.R"))
source(here::here("R","rq-apdf-to-punc.R"))
source(here::here("R","rq-apdf-to-pbwg.R"))     # todo- clean - need to load punc first.
source(here::here("03-traffic_characterization-graphs.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: read-LPPT-zip

lppt_zip    <- list.files(pth_apdf, pattern = "^LPPT-apdf")
whats_there <- check_zip_content(pth_apdf, lppt_zip)
whats_there
```

## Airport Traffic

For BRA-EUR, we use PBWG daily traffic stats as analytic data.

```{r}
# let's iterate over each year
whats_there <- whats_there |> mutate(YEAR = str_sub(Name, 13,16))

# loop for one
read_one_year <- function(.pth_apdf, .archive, .yr, ...){
  this_target <- whats_there |> dplyr::filter(YEAR == .yr)
  this_data   <- read_zip(.pth_apdf, .archive, .files = this_target$Name)
 #  this_data |> read_and_write_apt_tfc("LPPT", .yr)
}

# test-run: read_one_year(pth_apdf, lppt_zip, .yr = 2019) |> print()
# do all
whats_there$YEAR |> purrr::walk(.f = ~ read_one_year(pth_apdf, lppt_zip, .x))
```

## Airport Peak Traffic

based on BRA-EUR, i.e. 99th percentile   
the peak day (99th percentile) is calculated from the daily traffic stats

```{r}
lppt_annual_peak <- tfc_data |> bind_rows() |> peak_day_from_counts() |> 
    add_nbr_rwy() |> 
    mutate(REGION = "EUR")

lppt_annual_peak |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = PEAK_DAY_PCT)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = ICAO)) +
  geom_point()
```


## Airport Punctuality

```{r}
lppt_adpf <- read_zip(pth_apdf, lppt_zip)

# do it for one
calc_punc_for_df_with_delay <- function(.df){
  this_punc <- .df |> 
  prep_apdf() |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(ICAO = "LPPT") |> 
  add_delay_and_dlygrp() |> 
  package_pbwg_punc_analytic()
  return(this_punc)
}

punc_2019 <- lppt_adpf[[1]] |> calc_punc_for_df_with_delay()

# iterate over all
punc_lppt <-  lppt_adpf |> 
  purrr::map(.f = ~ .x |> calc_punc_for_df_with_delay())

# write out --- punctuality data for LPPT
# punc_lppt |> bind_rows() |> 
#  readr::write_csv(here::here("data","PBWG-EUR-PUNC-LPPT-2019-2024.csv"))
```

## Additional Taxi-Time

Per PBWG convention, we determine the reference times for the year 2024.

```{r}
source(here::here("R","rq-apdf-to-txxt.R"))
```


```{r}
lppt_2024 <- read_zip(pth_apdf, lppt_zip, "LPPT_01-JAN-2024_31-DEC-2024.gz.parquet")
txxt_ref_2024 <- lppt_2024 |> 
  rename(PHASE = SRC_PHASE, RWY = AP_C_RWY, STND = AP_C_STND) |>  
  prepare_eur_txxts() |> 
  calc_pct20_cases(ymd_hms("2024-01-01 00:00:00"), ymd_hms("2024-12-31 24:00:00")) |> 
  rename(N_2024 = N, REF_20_2024 = REF_20)

# compare with 2019
lppt_2019 <- read_zip(pth_apdf, lppt_zip, "LPPT_01-JAN-2019_31-DEC-2019.gz.parquet")
txxt_ref_2019 <- lppt_2019 |> 
  rename(PHASE = SRC_PHASE, RWY = AP_C_RWY, STND = AP_C_STND) |>  
  prepare_eur_txxts() |> 
  calc_pct20_cases(ymd_hms("2019-01-01 00:00:00"), ymd_hms("2019-12-31 24:00:00")) |> 
  rename(N_2019 = N, REF_20_2019 = REF_20)
# correct for runway change
txxt_ref_2019 <- txxt_ref_2019 |> 
  mutate( RWY_OLD = RWY
         ,RWY     = case_when(
                RWY %in% "03" ~ "02"
              , RWY %in% "21" ~ "20"
           )
         )
```

txxt_ref_2024 |> full_join(txxt_ref_2019, by = join_by(PHASE, RWY, STND)) |> 
  # mutate(DELTA = REF_20_2024 - REF_20_2019) |> write_csv(here::here("data-prep-eur","apt-txxt-ref-LPPT.csv"))

```{r}
# load reference taxi times for LPPT
lppt_txxt_refs <- read_csv(
      here::here("data-prep-eur","apt-txxt-ref-LPPT.csv")
    , show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  # force ref time for all cases ----------------------------
  mutate(REF_20_2024 = case_when(
      is.na(REF_20_2024) & !is.na(REF_20_2019) ~ REF_20_2019
    , .default = REF_20_2024)
    ) |> 
  select(PHASE, RWY, STND, REF = REF_20_2024)
```

```{r}
# load all movement data 2019-2024
lppt_txxts <- read_zip(pth_apdf, lppt_zip) |> bind_rows() |> 
  rename(PHASE = SRC_PHASE, RWY = AP_C_RWY, STND = AP_C_STND) |> 
  mutate(ICAO = "LPPT", .before = PHASE) |> 
  prepare_eur_txxts() |> 
  # account for runway change
  mutate(RWY = case_when(
                RWY %in% "03" ~ "02"
              , RWY %in% "21" ~ "20"
           )
  )
```

```{r}
lppt_txxts <- lppt_txxts |> 
  left_join(lppt_txxt_refs, by = join_by(PHASE, RWY, STND)) |> 
  mutate(ADD_TXXT = TXXT - REF)

lppt_txxt_add_times <- lppt_txxts |> 
  mutate(ICAO = "LPPT", DATE = date(BLOCK_TIME_UTC)) |> 
  group_by(ICAO, DATE, PHASE) |> 
  reframe( MVTS     = sum(!is.na(ADD_TXXT))
          ,TXXT     = sum(TXXT, na.rm = TRUE)
          ,ADD_TIME = sum(ADD_TXXT, na.rm = TRUE)
          ) |> 
  mutate(AVG_ADD_TIME = ADD_TIME / MVTS)
```

lppt_txxt_add_times |> mutate(PHASE = ifelse(PHASE == "ARR", "TXIT", "TXOT")) |> 
  write_csv(here::here("data","EUR-txxt-LPPT.csv"))

```{r}
lppt_txxt_add_times |> 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_path(aes(x = DATE, y = AVG_ADD_TIME, color = PHASE, group = PHASE)) +
  facet_wrap(.~ PHASE) +
  labs(subtitle = "daily variation additional taxi-times") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
